response.sql:
WITH operator_stats AS (
  SELECT crewref,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count,
         AVG(gbsize / spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_minute
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY crewref
),
all_operator_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS overall_avg
  FROM operator_stats
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT os.scan_count,
         os.avg_gb_per_minute,
         os.avg_gb_per_minute - aoa.overall_avg AS margin
  FROM operator_stats AS os
  CROSS JOIN all_operator_average AS aoa
  WHERE os.avg_gb_per_minute > aoa.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scan_count,
       AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
       AVG(margin) AS avg_margin_above_overall
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Each operator's scan count includes only records with both file size and nonzero duration, matching the rows usable to compute that operator's average GB per minute.

alternatives.interpretation: Count all scan records per operator, even when file size or duration is missing, while calculating the rate from nonmissing values with nonzero duration.

       AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute,
       AVG(margin) AS avg_margin_above_overall
FROM above_average;
